name: Smart Cupcake Stand
author: Addicting Games
description: Smart Cupcake Stand is a time-management game that incorporates math practice. Working in a cupcake shop can be tough, especially when each customer wants a custom order. On top of these unique orders, these customers have little patience and you must create the cupcake as quickly as you can! Once you’re done playing a round of the game, you will be served math questions that you must answer correctly in order to unlock another session. There are various math skills you can choose from like fractions, multiplication, geometry, and even statistics. This is a unique type of educational game that helps break up studying with a fun game!
